message.content: {"action":"increase_precision","reason":"The current LUT design (depth 256, linear, 12 phase bits) fails the 8-LSB accuracy check, and increasing precision to 14 bits was the only legal move that improved accuracy while keeping area moderate (1346 µm²). Since the 14-bit variant still fails the quality check and the other listed actions have no legal unvisited neighbors, the only available step that can further improve numerical quality is to increase precision again by one legal level."}
